browserVoice.note: Browser voice is NOT a second service. ops/voice-turn-server.mjs (127.0.0.1:4118) serves two extra routes on the same process and port. This workflow stays the GHL/voice-turn path and is untouched.

routes.body: audio bytes, or JSON { text } for a text-mode client
routes.returns: { transcript, transcriptSource, reply, actions, models, audioBase64, mimeType, ttsError }

browserVoice.identity: Both routes require the caller's own bearer. /voice/turn forwards THAT bearer to the Rosina service (4200), which forwards it to the MCP server, so transcription, tools and any reviewed action run as the signed-in caller. A GHL webhook credential is never accepted here.
browserVoice.secrets: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and META_API_KEY are read server-side only; neither is ever returned to the browser.
browserVoice.rateLimit: 12 turns per minute per caller on both routes (VOICE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN), keyed by a hash of the bearer; Rosina applies its own 20/min per person on top.
